q1.prompt: Two nested loops each run n times over the input. How do you name the growth?

choices.label: O(n²) — keep the leading term, drop fixed multipliers
Basically linear — nested loops are still "about n"

wrong_linear.explanation: Estimate growth by the leading term: two nested n-loops are O(n²). Calling that "basically linear" misleads capacity planning.

choices.label: Do not drop the leading term to sound friendlier; do not quote amortized O(1) when worst case was asked
Friendly wording beats precise leading terms

wrong_refuse.explanation: Do not drop the leading term to make the answer sound friendlier. Do not call a true double-n loop "basically linear." Do not quote amortized constant time when the question asked worst case.

success.prompt: You kept leading terms and avoided friendly but wrong growth claims.
